title: Global Development Progress Reverses Amid Financing Challenges
discussion_signal: The post links development setbacks to fragmentation, trade barriers, geopolitical tension, climate disasters, and a financing squeeze. Audience discussion adds a structural critique about debt dependence and unequal access to finance, extending the report framing toward power and distribution rather than treating financing as a neutral technical gap.
linked_research_question: How do geopolitical fragmentation and financial dependence narrow the public capacity to absorb social and climate shocks?
limits: Audience critique is not a representative view of the Global South
The discussion does not quantify the causal contribution of each financing pressure
